4864.o: Pick up Jaron’s Supplies from the snow, then find the wildkin that stole the amulet Jaron spoke of.$B$BBring Jaron’s Supplies and the Blue-feathered Amulet to Jaron Stoneshaper at the lodge in Winterspring.

4865.o: Report your findings to Motega Firemane.

4866.o: In the heart of Blackrock Spire you will find Mother Smolderweb. Engage her and get her to poison you. Chances are good that you will have to kill her as well. Return to Ragged John when you are poisoned so that he can ’milk’ you.

4867.o: Read Warosh’s Scroll.  Bring Warosh’s Mojo to Warosh.

4881.o: Warn Kanati Greycloud at Whitereach Post of the plot to kill him.

4882.o: Take the Blue-feathered Necklace to Trull Failbane at Bloodvenom Post.

4883.o: Take the Blue-feathered Necklace to Nara Wildmane.

4901.o: Protect Ranshalla while she attempts to reactivate the Altar of Elune. Report your findings to Erelas Ambersky in Rut’theran Village.

4902.o: Speak with Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm in Darnassus.

4903.o: Slay Highlord Omokk, War Master Voone, and Overlord Wyrmthalak. Recover Important Blackrock Documents. Return to Warlord Goretooth in Kargath when the mission has been accomplished.

4904.o: Escort Lakota Windsong from the Darkcloud Pinnacle, and then talk to Thalia Amberhide at Freewind Post.

4906.o: Eridan Bluewind in Felwood wants you to kill 8 Jadefire Hellcallers, 8 Jadefire Betrayers, 8 Jadefire Tricksters, and Xavaric. Return to Eridan when the task is completed.

4921.o: Find Mankrik’s wife and then return to him in the Crossroads.

4941.o: Speak with Eitrigg in Orgrimmar. When you have discussed matters with Eitrigg, seek council from Thrall.$B$BYou recall having seen Eitrigg in Thrall’s chamber.

4961.o: Kill the Demon of the Orb, then speak with Tabetha.

4962.o: Take the Felhas Ruby and use it on one of the Felhounds found in Desolace. After successful, bring the Felhas Ruby and the Imprisoned Felhound Spirit back to Menara Voidrender in the Barrens.

4963.o: Take the Infus Emerald and use it on one of the Infernals found in Desolace. After successful, bring the Infus Emerald and the Imprisoned Infernal Spirit back to Menara Voidrender in the Barrens.

4964.o: Wait for Menara Voidrender to complete the Orb of Dar’Orahil and then speak to her again.

4965.o: Speak to Menara Voidrender in the Barrens.

4966.o: Protect Kanati Greycloud from the centaur attack.

4967.o: Speak to Menara Voidrender in the Barrens.

4969.o: Speak to Menara Voidrender in the Barrens.

4970.o: Bring 5 Shardtooth Meat and 5 Chillwind Meat to Rivern Frostwind on Frostsaber Rock.

4971.o: Use the Temporal Displacer near one of Andorhal’s silos and uncover Temporal Parasites.$B$BSlay 10 Temporal Parasites, and then return the Temporal Displacer to Chromie in the Andorhal Inn, Western Plaguelands.

4972.o: Locate 5 Andorhal Watches, found in lockboxes amongst the rubble of the city.  Return with them to Chromie in the Andorhal Inn, Western Plaguelands.

4973.o: Locate 5 Andorhal Watches amongst the rubble of the city, and return with them to Chromie in the Andorhal Inn, Western Plaguelands.

4974.o: Travel to Blackrock Spire and slay Warchief Rend Blackhand. Take his head and return to Orgrimmar.

4975.o: Wait for Menara Voidrender to complete the Orb of Noh’Orahil and then speak to her again.

4976.o: Return the Cleansed Infernal Orb to Menara Voidrender in the Barrens.

4981.o: Travel to Blackrock Spire and find out what happened to Bijou.

4982.o: Find Bijou’s Belongings and return them to her. You recall her mentioning that she stashed them on the bottom floor of the city.$B

4983.o: Take Bijou’s Reconnaissance Report back to Grandmaster Lexlort in Kargath.$B

4984.o: Destroy 8 Diseased Wolves, and then return to Mulgris Deepriver at the Writhing Haunt, Western Plaguelands.$B$B

4985.o: Destroy 8 Diseased Grizzlies, and then return to Mulgris Deepriver at the Writhing Haunt, Western Plaguelands.

4986.o: Based on the magic enchanted within the Glyphed Oaken Branch, its delivery to the Cenarion Circle in Darnassus is the next step the tauren druid sought.  Seek one of the druids there for assistance.

4987.o: Based on the magic enchanted within the Glyphed Oaken Branch, its delivery to the Cenarion Circle in Thunder Bluff is the next step the tauren druid sought.  Seek one of the druids there for assistance.

5001.o: Find Bijou’s Belongings and return them to her. Good luck!$B

5002.o: Travel to the Burning Steppes and give Bijou’s Information to Marshal Maxwell.

5021.o: The ramblings of the ghostly woman indicated that she needed a package delivered.  She claimed that it was where her horse was.  As to where the horse is or where the package was to be delivered - the ghost remains incomprehensible.

5022.o: Check with the Royal Factors of Stormwind to learn the whereabouts of an Emma Felstone.  There is usually a census officer located in City Hall.

5023.o: Check with the Royal Overseers of the Undercity to learn the whereabouts of a Jeremiah Felstone.  There is usually a census officer located near guild and tabard registration.

5041.o: Find and return Crossroads’ Supply Crates to Thork in the Barrens.

5047.o: Talk to Malyfous Darkhammer in Everlook.

5048.o: Find Ol’ Emma in Stormwind and see if she is in fact Emma Felstone.  If she is, then perhaps she’d like the package Janice Felstone made for her.

5049.o: Find Jeremiah Payson in the Undercity and see if he is in fact Jeremiah Felstone.  If he is, then perhaps he’d like the package Janice Felstone made for him.

5050.o: Return to Janice Felstone in Western Plaguelands her Good Luck Half-Charm.

5051.o: Locate the other half of the Good Luck Charm somewhere on the Felstone Farm in Western Plaguelands and reassemble it.$B$BGive the Good Luck Charm to Janice Felstone on the Felstone Farm, Western Plaguelands.

5052.o: Bring a Blood Shard to Mangletooth in Camp Taurajo in the Barrens.$B$BCollect more Blood Shards if you want him to bless you with Agamaggan’s power.

5054.o: Storm Shadowhoof at Everlook in Winterspring wants you to kill Ursius.

5055.o: Storm Shadowhoof at Everlook in Winterspring wants you to kill Brumeran.

5056.o: Storm Shadowhoof at Everlook in Winterspring wants you to defeat Shy-Rotam.

5057.o: Bring Storm Shadowhoof’s Marker to Melor Stonehoof in Thunder Bluff.

5061.o: Return to Darnassus and show Mathrengyl Bearwalker the Pendant of the Sea Lion.

5062.o: Gather 10 bushels of Incendia Agave, and then consult Magatha Grimtotem on Elder Rise in Thunderbluff.

5063.o: In order to create the Cap of the Scarlet Savant, you will be required to bring the following items back to Malyfous Darkhammer: 1 Pristine Hide of the Beast; 5 Frayed Abomination Stitchings; 8 Arcane Crystals; 5 Enchanted Scarlet Thread. $B$BYou will also be required to pay 50 gold pieces for the crafting of the item.

5064.o: Locate and retrieve the three Secret Notes in Darkcloud Pinnacle.

5065.o: Bring the Third and Fourth Mosh’aru Tablets to Prospector Ironboot in Tanaris.

5066.o: Seek out Commander Ashlam Valorfist.  His base camp is located at Chillwind Camp, north of the Alterac Mountains.

5067.o: In order to create the Leggings of Arcana, you will be required to bring the following items back to Malyfous Darkhammer: 1 Pristine Hide of the Beast; 5 Frayed Abomination Stitchings; 5 Arcanite Bars; 5 Frostwhisper’s Embalming Fluid.$B$BYou will also be required to pay 50 gold pieces for the crafting of the item.

5068.o: In order to create the Breastplate of Bloodthirst, you will be required to bring the following items back to Malyfous Darkhammer: 1 Pristine Hide of the Beast; 10 Frayed Abomination Stitchings; 5 Arcanite Bars; 5 Skin of Shadow.$B$BYou will also be required to pay 50 gold pieces for the crafting of the item.

5081.o: Travel to Blackrock Spire and destroy War Master Voone, Highlord Omokk, and Overlord Wyrmthalak. Return to Marshal Maxwell when the job is done.

5082.o: Donova Snowden in Winterspring wants you to kill 8 Winterfall Pathfinders, 8 Winterfall Den Watchers, and 8 Winterfall Totemics.

5083.o: Bring the Empty Firewater Flask to Donova Snowden in Winterspring.

5084.o: Search the Deadwood furbolg camp in northern Felwood for a clue.

5085.o: Report back to Donova Snowden with your findings.

5086.o: Collect 3 Toxic Horror Droplets for Donova Snowden in Winterspring.

5087.o: Find the Winterfall Runners and stop them from delivering their shipment to Winterfall Village.

5088.o: Slay Arikara. Bring her remains and the Incendia powder to Motega Firemane in Whitereach Post as proof of your deed.

5089.o: Take General Drakkisath’s Command to Marshal Maxwell in Burning Steppes.

5090.o: Seek out Commander Ashlam Valorfist.  His base camp is located at Chillwind Camp, north of the Alterac Mountains.

5091.o: Seek out Commander Ashlam Valorfist.  His base camp is located at Chillwind Camp, north of the Alterac Mountains.

5095.o: Seek out High Executor Derrington.  His base camp is located at the Bulwark, east of Tirisfal Glades and the Undercity.

5096.o: Proceed to the Scarlet Crusade’s base camp between Felstone Field and Dalson’s Tears and destroy their command tent.$B$BPlace the Scourge banner at the camp, and then return to High Executor Derrington at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

5097.o: Using the Beacon Torch, mark each tower in Andorhal; you will need to stand in the doorway of the tower to successfully mark it.$B$BOnce all four towers are marked, return the Beacon Torch to Commander Ashlam Valorfist in Chillwind Camp, Western Plaguelands.

5098.o: Using the Beacon Torch, mark each tower in Andorhal; you will need to stand in the doorway of the tower to successfully mark it.$B$BOnce all four towers are marked, return the Beacon Torch to High Executor Derrington at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

5102.o: Travel to Blackrock Spire and destroy General Drakkisath. Return to Marshal Maxwell when the job is done.$B
